column4: Malformed encoded text is reported as damaged instead of being silently replaced with different identities or build information.
Existing rebuildable indexes and statistics caches refresh once so old replacement text cannot remain trusted.
Added malformed and valid Unicode checks, including byte-for-byte preservation of a repaired tail backup.
Android verification now archives both the healing confirmation and threshold-setting screenshots.
Recorded TEST99's passing tests and its missing archived images, plus this batch's reproduced data-integrity failures.

I tightened damaged-text handling so statistics do not invent identities from corrupted recordings. Existing caches rebuild from the original logs, and the Android checks now retain the new healing screenshots.
